'''Bolt Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter]]s employed by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] to patrol the area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[PharmCom Orbital Processing Plant One]], a pharmaceutical production facility. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Bolt Squadron attempted to prevent [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from leaving Coruscant, as it was suspected that he was carrying [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on board, whom the Galactic Alliance believed were their property. Solo, however, managed to escape to [[Shedu Maad]].
